label: Drought: baseline SPEI-12
quantity: Standardized precipitation evapotranspiration index over 12 months
temporal_statistic: 12-month accumulation; event, frequency or reference-period summary unresolved
blockers: Define temporal summary, reference period, geography and drought classification. Verify SPEI product/version and units; an event-severity rule is not automatically a long-term priority rule.

label: Heat: baseline maximum temperature
quantity: Maximum temperature of warmest month (candidate BIO5)
blockers: Verify BIO5 band, scale and period. This is not heat-stress days per year; justify metric, relevance and classification.

label: Flood: baseline rainfall proxy
quantity: Wettest-month precipitation proposed historically as a flood proxy
blockers: Historical candidate is precipitation, not inundation depth, probability or damage. Resolve flood metric and dataset before classification; do not silently relabel rainfall as flood depth.

label: Agricultural land exposure
quantity: Cropland or grazing-land extent/fraction; class selection unresolved
blockers: Specify land-cover classes, agricultural scope, denominator and support. Exposure context only; no default priority weight.

label: Rural population exposure
quantity: Rural population density; rural mask unresolved
blockers: Verify dataset, units, year and rural mask. Keep descriptive; do not promote a T5 population descriptor into an additive priority through this alias.

label: Soil degradation sensitivity
quantity: Historical combination of low organic carbon and texture; metric unresolved
blockers: Separate quantity, depth and units; low carbon and sand content are not a defined degradation index. Resolve overlap with T5 soil variables; no vulnerability-index default.

label: Road access: operational context
quantity: Distance to road; network and distance definition unresolved
blockers: Define road classes, distance metric, date and binding. Distance is not travel time. Route to operational investment-risk/context; exclude from climate-need priority sum.

label: Drought: future SPEI-12
quantity: Intended future standardized precipitation evapotranspiration index over 12 months
temporal_statistic: 12-month accumulation; horizon and temporal summary unresolved
blockers: Historical dataset pointer supplies bioclimatic layers, not a verified SPEI time series. Define derivation, ensemble, horizon and common baseline/future reference; do not count both scenarios twice.

label: Flood: runoff depth candidate
blockers: Dataset ID says SCS-CN runoff but archived T1 metadata describes HydroSHEDS. Resolve product, derivation and time support. Runoff is not inundation depth; test overlap with flood and water-harvesting concerns.

label: Rainfall variability
temporal_statistic: Interannual; seasonal window and period unresolved
blockers: Historical CHIRPS dataset ID has WorldClim metadata. Verify actual time series; specify CV, standard deviation or another justified statistic with units. A climatology cannot establish interannual variability.

label: Soil permeability sensitivity
quantity: Soil permeability or water retention; quantity unresolved
blockers: Select actual property and units; texture is not measured permeability and permeability is not retention. Validate derivation, depth and relevance; no default sensitivity score.
